page.layout: One page: a chronological table. Left margin holds marginal notes beside the rows. Centre is a ruled column of entries. Right margin holds the year numbers, 1358 to 1371, beside the rules. Page number "16" printed at the top centre. No running head.

l.note: Albertus Bavarus confirmat Groninganis ius negociationum p provincias suas.

page.notes: The left-margin notes are set beside the rows of years, and the year numbers stand in the right margin. The rows of the table have ruled lines but no text, apart from the names at 1370 and "Idem sex." at 1371. Names are set in an italic, script-like face and are copied as seen. Doubtful: "Selwerdica" (could read Selvverdica), "Albert Calmar" (a letter before "Albert" is unclear), and "Hümerciis" (the umlaut may be a damaged mark). The "p" in the Albertus note may be an abbreviation mark. The left-margin note for Celebre is split across two lines in print and is joined here.
